title: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18683v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally invalid actions in preferred trajectories and ignores the downstream cascading influence of early pivotal deviations in unpreferred ones. translated_title: ProAS：一种面向多轮智能体强化学习的进度感知优势塑形框架
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为优化大语言模型（LLM）智能体的主要范式，然而高效的免评论家（critic-free）算法（如GRPO）存在一个根本性的均匀信用分配困境——它将轨迹级别的优势平均地分配给所有动作。我们的分析揭示，这种均匀性本质上会强化偏好轨迹中结构上无效的动作，并且忽略了非偏好轨迹中早期关键偏差对下游的级联影响。为了在不引入评论家开销的情况下解决这一问题，我们提出了进度感知优势塑形（ProAS），这是一个即插即用的框架，它利用一个动态演化的智能体参考图（ARG），通过屏蔽不合理激励（MUI）和非对称惩罚再分配（APR）来实现细粒度的信用分配。在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上的大量实验表明，ProAS普遍提升（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: ProAS是一个即插即用的优势塑形框架，它利用动态演化的智能体参考图（ARG）通过屏蔽不合理激励和非对称惩罚再分配实现细粒度信用分配，解决了GRPO等免评论家算法将轨迹优势均匀分配给所有动作、从而强化无效动作并忽略早期关键偏差级联影响的根本缺陷。
en_tdlr: ProAS is a plug-and-play advantage shaping framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment, resolving GRPO's fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that reinforces invalid actions and ignores the cascading impact of early pivotal deviations.
